notablePrerequisites: Rancor attached to another creature you control.
description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature with Rancor attached, adding {G}.
When Rancor leaves the battlefield, it and Warehouse Tabby trigger.
Resolve the Warehouse Tabby trigger, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Resolve the Rancor trigger, returning it to your hand from your graveyard.
Cast Rancor by paying {G}, attaching it to the Rat token.
Repeat.
